records.subject: You're in -- let's get Bright Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Positive engagement (onboarding call held [calendar:786d1109], upbeat ticket tick_7e498ef5d813 asking about future seats) suggests intent, but 6 days in there's still no project, no invite, no milestone, and no customer-initiated contact since 19 Aug [email:04e2f864]. 8 days left; modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: Getting Bright Ventures' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Glad the onboarding felt smooth — and to confirm what Tariq mentioned, seats can be added any time from Account Settings, so you're covered there as the team grows.

Since our call, I wanted to check in on the first setup step: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
